_doc: Shape kits. radius values are px. border is the default component border width in px. elevation names a kit in elevations below. pad is the base control padding scale (y, x) in px for the medium control. describe is prose for DESIGN.md.

flat.describe: No shadows. Depth comes from tone steps and 1px rules.

tonal.describe: Depth comes from lighter or darker surface tones. Shadows are rare and very faint.

soft.describe: Wide, low-opacity shadows tinted with the brand hue, never pure black.

crisp.describe: Tight, short shadows with a clear edge, like paper lifted a few millimetres.

offset.describe: Hard, unblurred offset shadows in the ink color, like a printed sticker.

sharp.describe: Square corners and fine rules. It reads exact, serious and printed.

crisp.describe: Small, even radii. Friendly enough, but still precise.

soft.describe: Generous radii on everything. Nothing has a hard corner, so the screen feels safe.

pebble.describe: Big, pebble-like shapes with no outlines. Tone changes do the separating.

pill.describe: Pill-shaped controls and chips, with softly rounded cards around them.

mixed.describe: Square cards and images, pill-shaped buttons. The contrast is the signature.

brut.describe: Thick borders, small radii and hard offset shadows. Loud on purpose.

rules.describe: No boxes. Hairline rules and spacing carry the structure.
